title: Moonstone
idea: A new material drawn by a look family: Moon Frost, or any cold cast as strong, turns bare ground into shining blocks of moonstone. No code, no asset.

add.log: The ground sets into shining moonstone

spells.name: Moon Frost
spells.blurb: Level 2. A hush of pale light: the ground where it lands sets into blocks of moonstone that shine in the dark.
